capabilities: Track workouts in an active session view with rest and session timers
Manage exercises, routines and plans as linked markdown notes
Import workout history from Strong and extract routines from completed workouts
Browse a bundled catalog of 1,324 exercises with descriptions
Append every completed set to a flat performance CSV
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Exercise images are not bundled: notes link to a CDN, and users who want no network use must set Exercise images to No image. Hevy import is planned but not yet available.
motivation: The author cites the hard first setup of fitness tracking — building an exercise library and migrating routines and history — as the reason for bundling a 1,324-exercise catalog and a Strong import.
problem: Fitness apps lock workout history in proprietary databases, and Obsidian has no built-in way to log training as plain-text notes inside the vault.

relations.evidence: simply export your history from there and get it into your vault with the "Import from Strong" feature

summary: Workout tracker that stores exercises, routines, plans and logged sessions as markdown notes, with an app-like active session view, dashboard and Strong import.
